AttributeScope.description:
Whether an attribute applies to the whole catalogue or only within one category — what stops
"Size" meaning shoe size in one branch and screen size in another.

CreatePartnerRequest.description: Null limits take the spec defaults; they do not mean "no limit".

IssueKeyRequest.description: Null scopes mean every scope the partner holds, which is the usual case.

ProductIdentifierType.description:
The kinds of identifier a product can be matched on, in descending order of how much they
prove. A GTIN identifies the article worldwide; a source id identifies it only within the one
system it came from, which is why that one carries a domain.

RotateKeyRequest.description:
Hours rather than a TimeSpan: an overlap is an operational decision expressed in hours, and a
JSON TimeSpan is a format callers get wrong. Null takes the configured default.

UpdateCommerceLimitsRequest.description: Amounts are two-decimal strings; see SettingsAdminEndpoints.

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
No email field. Keycloak owns the address for a website account, so accepting one here would
let a customer set a value the next sign-in silently overwrites.

Backoffice.description: Keycloak SSO login for the 'Backoffice' realm (Authorization Code + PKCE).

Shop.description: Keycloak SSO login for the 'Shop' realm (Authorization Code + PKCE).

PartnerApiKey.description: A partner API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer pk_...`. Keys are issued by the seller and carry their own scopes and rate limit.
